name: FTB-Genesis
description: FTB Genesis Modded Minecraft Server FTB Genesis Suspended in a corrupt simulation, your people need you to restore Elyria's habitat free them from the decaying digital landscape. Mutated monsters and irradiated wastelands stand between you and the fate of a world on the precipice of extinction. Version tags available: - 1.9.1 - 1.8.1 - 1.8.0 - 1.7.0 - 1.6.1 - 1.6.0 - 1.5.0 - 1.4.0 - 1.3.2 - 1.3.1 - 1.3.0 - 1.2.2 - 1.2.1 - 1.2.0 - 1.1.1 Setup: [li]You must accept the EULA by setting the EULA variable to true or the install will fail. Optional: [li]You can setup a comma separated list of players who will have admin privileges in game by setting OPS
